when_used: A registered proprietor appoints an attorney to do anything in relation to the proprietor's interest in a title that the proprietor could do.

body_text.text: The Donor HEREBY APPOINT(S) the Donee to be the Attorney of the Donor and generally in relation to the Donor’s interest in the above-mentioned Title to do anything and everything that the Donor could do, and for the Donor and in the name of the Donor to execute all such instruments and to do all such acts, matters and things as may be necessary or expedient for carrying out the powers hereby given.
SIGNED as a Deed by the Donor ………….... day of .……………20…...
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this power of Attorney has been duly executed this........................…. day of………………..20…………….

registry_block: REGISTERED in the Register of Powers of Attorney as No........................ this …………………................... day of …………………............. 20…….
foot_notes: indicate: Name; I.D/Passport No./PIN. If corporate body, provide registration details.

custom_fields.name: donor_pin
custom_fields.label: PIN of the Donor
custom_fields.prompt: Personal Identification Number of the registered proprietor giving the power

custom_fields.name: donee_registration_no
custom_fields.label: Registration number of the Donee
custom_fields.prompt: Company or other registration number of the Donee, where the Donee is a body corporate

custom_fields.name: donee_postal_address
custom_fields.label: Postal address of the Donee
custom_fields.prompt: Postal address of the Donee, for example 1-00100 Nairobi

custom_fields.name: donee_address_for_service
custom_fields.label: Address for service of the Donee
custom_fields.prompt: Address within Kenya at which documents may be served on the Donee
